scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.gen:client: uv run --directory apps/api python -m bide_comply.openapi ../../packages/api-client/openapi.json && pnpm --filter @bide-comply/api-client gen
scripts.lint: eslint . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff check
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
